title: Geothermal Electricity Ordinance Extraction Schema
description: Extract regulatory requirements from geothermal electricity ordinances. EXTRACTION SCOPE: Only geothermal ELECTRICITY (geothermal power plants, geothermal production/injection wells for electricity generation, commercial geothermal energy facilities). EXCLUDE: geothermal heat pumps (GHP), residential geothermal HVAC, direct-use geothermal heating/cooling, solar power, wind power, and all other non-geothermal renewable energy sources.

applies_to_geothermal_electricity.description: True if ordinance regulates geothermal ELECTRICITY generation (geothermal power plants, geothermal wells for electricity production). False if only GHP, residential heating, solar, wind, or other non-geothermal energy.

summary.description: Brief summary: What sections apply to geothermal electricity, or why document was excluded. Examples: 'Extracted Chapter 10 provisions for commercial geothermal power production', 'Document addresses only solar/wind energy - excluded', 'Document only covers residential GHP systems - excluded'.

state.description: State name exactly as written in document (e.g., 'California', 'Nevada', 'Colorado').

county.description: County name exactly as written (e.g., 'Imperial County', 'Chaffee County'). Do not remove 'County' suffix.

ordinance_code.description: Ordinance number/code exactly as written (e.g., 'Chapter 26.138', 'Resolution 2013-33', 'Division 17'). Leave null if not stated.

requirements.description: Array of distinct GEOTHERMAL ELECTRICITY requirements ONLY. DO NOT extract requirements for solar power, wind power, biomass, or other non-geothermal energy sources - SKIP THOSE ENTIRELY. Each unique geothermal requirement = one entry. Extract exactly as stated - do not infer or combine unless explicitly stated together in ordinance. FOR SETBACKS: If text states '40 feet from street, 15 feet from property line', create TWO separate entries with different targets. CORRECT: target='Street/road right-of-way', value=40. INCORRECT: target='Power plant'.

subtype.description: Specific subcategory for additional detail. Examples: 'Drilling operations', 'Power plant operations', 'Production well', 'Injection well', 'Exploration phase'. Leave null if not applicable.

target.description: CRITICAL FOR SETBACKS: Specify what the distance is measured FROM (the reference point). Examples: setback FROM 'Residence', FROM 'Property line', FROM 'Rivers/streams'. For NON-SETBACK requirements: what the requirement applies TO (e.g., 'All facilities', 'Production wells'). NEVER use 'Power plant' as setback target - identify the actual feature being set back FROM.

value.description: Numeric requirement exactly as stated (e.g., 300, 1320, 65, 7.5) or time range (e.g., '7 a.m. to 7 p.m.', '24 hours'). Extract numbers without units. For yes/no requirements, use null and describe in details field. Examples: '1,320 feet' → 1320; '65 dBA' → 65; '$10,000' → 10000.

unit.description: Unit of measurement exactly as written in ordinance (e.g., 'feet', 'dBA', 'acres', 'days'). Leave null if no unit or for yes/no requirements.

details.description: Complete requirement text extracted verbatim from ordinance. Include all conditions, exceptions, qualifications exactly as written. This is the authoritative source - preserve exact legal language. Do NOT paraphrase or summarize.

section.description: Ordinance section reference exactly as cited (e.g., '§ 91703.01 G', 'Section 10-404(2)(c)', 'Chapter 26.138.050'). If same requirement appears in multiple sections, list all separated by commas. Leave null only if ordinance has no section numbering.
